result.title: Gearbox transmission error, Staubli TX2-40 axes 2 and 3
result.system: Staubli TX2-40 gearboxes on an experimental setup
result.quantity: theta_TE (rad), as published, at every published sample
result.baseline: B0: constant transmission error equal to the identification mean, per axis
result.model: MotionProof TE: c0 + (b/2) sign(q_set_dot) + sum_k [a_k sin(k q_set) + c_k cos(k q_set)], the periodic TE term and dead-band offset of the drive model; orders k: the 30 largest integer orders 1..4000 cycles per joint revolution in the identification spectrum (uniform q grid, step 1e-4 rad)
result.acceptance: per axis: validation RMSE(model) <= 0.5 x validation RMSE(B0) and validation RMSE(model) <= 1.5 x identification RMSE(model); X1 passes only if both axes pass
